tables.name: students
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, marks INTEGER NOT NULL

tables.name: courses
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL

tables.name: enrolments
tables.definition: student_id INTEGER REFERENCES students(id), course_id INTEGER REFERENCES courses(id), term TEXT, PRIMARY KEY(student_id,course_id,term)

title: Employee Management
description: Teams, reporting lines and employee salaries.

tables.name: departments
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL

tables.name: employees
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department_id INTEGER REFERENCES departments(id), manager_id INTEGER REFERENCES employees(id), salary INTEGER

title: E-commerce
description: Customers, products and order line items.

tables.name: customers
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT

tables.name: products
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, price_cents INTEGER

tables.name: orders
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, customer_id INTEGER REFERENCES customers(id), ordered_on TEXT

tables.name: order_items
tables.definition: order_id INTEGER REFERENCES orders(id), product_id INTEGER REFERENCES products(id), quantity INTEGER, unit_price_cents INTEGER, PRIMARY KEY(order_id, product_id)

title: Library Management
description: Titles, authors, members and book loans.

tables.name: authors
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT

tables.name: books
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, author_id INTEGER REFERENCES authors(id)

tables.name: members
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT

tables.name: loans
tables.definition: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, book_id INTEGER REFERENCES books(id), member_id INTEGER REFERENCES members(id), loaned_on TEXT, returned_on TEXT
